Package eu.algites.lib.journal.impl.common

Class AIcInMemoryJournal<E extends eu.algites.lib.journal.AIiJournalEntry,X extends Exception>

java.lang.Object
eu.algites.lib.journal.impl.common.AIcInMemoryJournal<E,X>
All Implemented Interfaces:
eu.algites.lib.journal.AIiJournal<E,X>, eu.algites.lib.journal.AIiReadOnlyJournal<E>
public final class AIcInMemoryJournal<E extends eu.algites.lib.journal.AIiJournalEntry,X extends Exception> extends Object implements eu.algites.lib.journal.AIiJournal<E,X>
Thread-safe, in-memory append-only journal. A write lock protects before-listener validation and atomic batch publication. After-listener notifications are queued in commit order and dispatched outside the write lock, including when a listener recursively appends another batch. Entries themselves must be immutable, as required by AIiJournalEntry.
